summary: Terminal independent adjudication: NARROW A and NARROW B, source 1d73d13d7c735ca1ea91acd2079ba8f7563473bb, review 3c95ad7f927d46a582bd932e5fb02547 (Reviewer4 CR seq11136), Worker22 original task automation-client-release-red-diagnostic-20261122 pinned spec blob 2559cd5bb1928725a7d3d5b69a537c2e79a60aeb. Actual frozen analyze_release.py inspected and independently reasoned: (A) parse_trx retains declared Counters but classify uses only UnitTestResult failures and exit=0; it never validates ResultSummary outcome or counters; review synthetic one Passed + summary Failed/total2 passed1 failed1 can falsely PASS. Valid bounded defect against complete, fail-closed TRX contract; not proof of original NUnit failure. NARROW remedy: require a valid positive ResultSummary and consistent numeric counters/outcomes before PASS; missing/malformed/contradictory evidence => UNKNOWN or RED with reason (not PASS), preserve genuine skipped/notExecuted and NUnit TRX semantics; realistic positive and contradiction/zero-summary/invalid-counter negative tests. (B) classify validates dotnet test+project/unfiltered but no Release switch; review Debug -c Debug with valid green TRX can falsely PASS. Valid direct scope violation. NARROW remedy: explicitly require one unambiguous Release configuration in command, reject Debug/omitted/multiple-conflicting switches, support documented -c/--configuration syntax; Debug and conflict negative tests, valid Release positive. Avoid excessive arbitrary exact argv matching. Both P2 diagnostic classifier-only; no proof first-party production or Client.Tests fault, no architecture rewrite. Authorize ONLY Worker22 to correct original new scripts/tests/automation-client-release-diagnostics-20261122/** and docs/testing/automation-client-release-diagnostics-20261122.md after Lead exact custody approval, new immutable frozen source/review and parser positives+negatives; no existing tests/fsproj/prod edits. Reviewer CR preserved, this adjudication is not acceptance or integration.
